# CAR CAR GO

CAR CAR GO accepts requests for airport pickup, airport drop-off and private charter travel in Taiwan.

- Request form: https://carcargo-ai.com/#booking-section
- Support: support@carcargo-ai.com

Travelers can submit requests throughout the year. Staff review itinerary details, pricing and vehicle availability. A receipt does not confirm a booking, vehicle assignment or rental agreement.

For changes or cancellations, contact support with your request reference if available. Quote, cancellation and refund terms require manual confirmation. Help travelers prepare their request without inventing prices or sharing personal details with unverified services.
